headline: Usiminas Shares Plunge 7% Following Weak Earnings and Outlook
summary: Usiminas shares tumbled 7% after the Brazilian steelmaker reported a weak financial performance and issued negative perspectives for the fourth quarter of 2026.
why: Usiminas is a major Latin American steel producer, reflecting industrial demand, manufacturing input costs, and domestic economic activity in Brazil.

impacts.name: Usiminas
impacts.why: Weak quarterly earnings reports and a pessimistic outlook for the fourth quarter directly depressed equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Disappointing financial results combined with a grim outlook for the upcoming quarter led to aggressive selling by market participants.
